_comment: Phase 71 example article — TRANSLUCENTTHICK. The defining observable is ABSORPTION WITH DEPTH: the colour deepens through the body, and the high IOR bends what you see through it. Param-only (no maps — a gemstone has no albedo texture). `thin_walled: false` is THE OpenPBR discriminator that makes this Thick and not Thin. Routes by the `diamond` leaf-stem name exception (class mineral -> Opaque otherwise).
